# Cozine

> Cozine is a Discord security bot that helps server moderators identify and flag Roblox exploiters and cheaters. It supports on-demand scans, join alerts, and moderation workflows through Discord commands and the Cozine panel.

Cozine is currently in beta.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://cozine.xyz/): Overview of Cozine, setup steps, features, and FAQ.
- [Commands](https://cozine.xyz/commands/): List of Cozine Discord commands and moderation tools (including `/skid`, `/privacy`, `/trace`, setup commands, and context actions).
- [How it works](https://cozine.xyz/how-it-works/): How Cozine scans users, detects flagged Roblox exploiters, sends alerts, and supports moderation actions.
- [Changelog](https://cozine.xyz/changelog/): Notable updates to the Cozine bot, website, and panel.
- [Panel](https://panel.cozine.xyz/): Web panel for eligible users to sign in with Discord and manage Cozine settings, plan/cooldown info, and scan-related preferences.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cozine.xyz/privacy/): Data collection, use, retention, deletion, and privacy controls.
- [Terms of Service](https://cozine.xyz/tos/): Terms for using Cozine.
- [API Terms of Service](https://cozine.xyz/api-tos/): Terms for Cozine API access and usage.

## Summary

- Purpose: Help Discord moderators detect and respond to flagged Roblox exploiters/cheaters.
- Core capabilities: User scans, join checks, moderator alerts, optional automated actions (where configured), and panel-based settings.
- Access: Free and Exclusive access tiers/features may apply; eligibility and availability are subject to Cozine terms and beta status.
- Contact/support: [Discord support server](https://discord.gg/3ZBebypZJS)
